target_customer: Payments companies such as issuers, acquirers, processors, gateways, ISOs and payfacs, and engineering teams that want governed coding agents
problem: Payments, risk, compliance and support teams run manual workflows over money movement. Runtime runs agents in the customer's cloud that ask for approval before acting.
business_model: Platform fee plus compute, hosted free tier and self-hosted option, per the founders
product_category: AI agent harness for payment operations

founders.name: Gus Trigos
previous_startups: Mentum, YC S21, acquired by Nuvocargo in April 2026
founders.background_notes: YC page: two-time YC founder, started as a quant at BlackRock's AI Quantitative Investment Group. Nuvocargo CEO letter confirms the Mentum acquisition.

founders.name: Carlos Volante
founders.background_notes: YC page: high-volume financial infrastructure and billing systems.

competitors.name: End Close (YC W26)
competitors.what: AI agents that investigate and resolve reconciliation exceptions

competitors.name: Ordway
competitors.what: AI agent matching incoming payments to invoices, launched February 2026

technical_complexity.rationale: Agent harness with approvals, audit trails, PCI and PII masking and deployment in customer clouds is standard but compliance heavy, and the site cites SOC 2 Type II.

defensibility.rationale: Agent frameworks are widely available and payment platforms add AI features. Deep workflow integrations in a customer's cloud could give some lock-in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Payment platforms offered built-in reconciliation tools in 2026; no copying outcome reported.

market_need_then: The site says customer Rain saved 750k in vendor and salary spend. Payments teams run heavy manual reconciliation and support work; Forbes featured the company on June 4, 2026.

branding.domain_note: Uses runtm.com, a vowel-dropped variant rather than runtime.com

identity.visual_style: Product demos, Slack threads and approval prompts
identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and operational, short punchy headlines aimed at finance and risk operators

branding.community_and_virality: Featured in Forbes on June 4, 2026 per the company site

brand_strength.rationale: Runtime is a generic term shared by many products and a branding search found only unrelated trademarks; the .com is not owned.

pivots.why: Third-party listings describe the coding agent product while the YC page and site describe payments; the reason is not stated and the sequence is unconfirmed

outcome_analysis: Runtime joined YC in Spring 2026 with a CEO who sold his previous YC company to Nuvocargo that April and a CTO from payments infrastructure. It cites Rain and Finix as customers and Forbes coverage, but funding and revenue are not public. Some listings describe a coding agent sandbox product, so positioning is not settled.
notes: Funding unverified: aggregators list 500K pre-seed, no investors, so no round recorded. YC pages say Spring 2026; the CSV says Spring 2026. The pivot entry rests on conflicting third-party descriptions. Education not found. Competitors are 2026 results, not specific to Runtime's founding.
